## Emerald 2.3.1-dev.1

First development build of 2.3.1, adding live inline image previews.

- Insert or paste a cover at the beginning of a list item, then type the song
  title and artist beside it. The image stays rendered while you edit the text.
- Inline covers default to thumbnails up to 96 pixels. Existing width and
  height hints work in both Edit and Read Mode, for example
  `- ![Cover|64](cover.jpg) **Song title** — Artist`.
- Move the caret into the image's Markdown to edit its path or size.
- Standalone image previews and plain Markdown storage remain supported.

### Testing notes

- Try insertion, clipboard images, and image drops in ordinary and task lists.
- Edit surrounding text, move into and out of image syntax, select/copy, and undo.
- Check wrapped lines, multiple images, missing files, and switching Read Mode.
